title: Law entry
description: One law (or one section of a law) that protects people who raise concerns about AI.

id.description: Lowercase slug used in page URLs: {jurisdiction}-{bill or short name}-{year}, e.g. us-ca-sb53-2025. Never include status, so URLs survive a status change.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter code, optionally with a subdivision, e.g. EU, UK, US, US-CA.

law.description: Common name of the instrument now in force, e.g. California SB 53 (2025).

section.description: Where in the law the protections are, e.g. Article 87 or Labor Code §§ 1107–1107.2. With law, forms the citation.

status.description: ended = lapsed, vetoed, withdrawn or repealed. 'In force' is derived: enacted and effective_date <= today.

effective_date.description: When the core anti-retaliation protection first applies. Omit if proposed or unknown.

protections.description: List a value only when the text clearly grants it. anti_retaliation: bans dismissal or other detriment. confidentiality: recipient must protect the reporter's identity. nda_override: contracts or waivers cannot block a protected report. individual_remedy: the reporter can bring their own claim (reinstatement, damages, fees, injunction).

reporting_channels.description: Recipients the law protects disclosures to.

limits.description: Limits of the protection, each ending with its citation in brackets, e.g. 'Protects only risk staff (LC 1107(b))'. Prefix inferences with 'Inference:'.

title.description: Link text; mark third-party summaries with '(secondary)'.

last_verified.description: Date every source was checked against the live text. null = unverified.

date.description: The pattern is enforced even by validators that treat 'format' as an annotation only.

type.description: authority = any government body (regulator, prosecutor, legislature).

name.description: The recipient as the law words it; name a specific body only if an official source does.

anonymous.description: Omit if the law is silent or leaves it to national law.

note.description: Conditions or eligibility, e.g. 'Only if a condition in Art 15(1) is met'.
